ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to 6 months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause because the Agreement gives us no right to our data back or to migration help when it ends (Section 16.5 even cross-refers to a Section 11 that does not exist). Our position is up to 6 months' transition assistance at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter.
input.summary: Insert Section 10.3: transition assistance up to 6 months at then-current rates, Customer Data return in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter.
